about.title: About this page
about.p1: This application is designed as a SPA (Single Page Application) to manage and explore food dishes.
about.p2: It includes features such as dish listing, individual detail view, star rating, and data management through Supabase.
about.p3: The goal is to offer a simple, visual, and practical experience to learn and demonstrate good web development practices.
home.title: Welcome to Foodie SPA
home.subtitle: Discover unique dishes, authentic flavors, and experiences that will make you travel.
